availability: Evaluate only accessible, ungated, license-permitted methods; record unavailable reasons; do not accept terms or download over 1 GB.

T2a.geometry: T1xCache.reaction(cache_index).x_ts and z; parent anchor reactant

T2b.selection: sha256(candidate_id) ascending, at most 8 per parent
T2b.metric: within_parent_rho min_n=4; at least 2 different target values

interval: cluster_summary, split_group formula clusters, two-sided 95% t interval
comparisons: paired parent rho difference of each method minus GFN2-xTB, separately for T2a and T2b; lower>0 BETTER_THAN_GFN2; upper<0 WORSE_THAN_GFN2; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
failure_policy: record all failures; ranking on finite data only; paired comparisons use intersecting parent IDs; reproduction failure invalidates downstream interpretation
determinism: sort parent IDs, channel IDs and candidate hashes; exclude timing from numerical inference
